purpose: P0 development pilot only; no architecture approval
execution_surface: Codex/Work-compatible model tiers or API adapter with provider-native usage telemetry

allowed_triggers: executor cannot produce a candidate state within the run timeout
executor explicitly reports inability/blocker before candidate verification
candidate reaches frozen verifier and mandatory V1/V2 evidence fails
escalation_certificate.state_rule: escalation starts from the same frozen task base plus compact factual failure certificate; do not pass hidden chain-of-thought or unbounded prior transcript

E3.policy_basis: pre-outcome structural task-family complexity hypothesis; experimental arm only

telemetry_requirements: provider-native usage record or raw response
all retries/escalations retained under parent run
freeze_rules: do not change E0-E3 after observing P0 outcomes
if a selected model/surface is unavailable, mark run INCONCLUSIVE and amend protocol prospectively rather than silently substitute
subscription credits are not treated as zero economic cost; token-equivalent accounting remains primary
